new_value: {"notes":"Implemented portable C dialect detection in lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt: probe final -std=c23 spelling first, fall back only to supported -std=c2x, fatal configure if neither exists. Zephyr v3.7 appends its configured C99 dialect after module target options, so the selected dialect is applied through its late global CSTD hook; LICHEN hardening warnings remain target-scoped. Pinned SDK 0.16.8 GCC 12.2 evidence: c23 probe FAILED, c2x probe SUCCESS, status reports LICHEN: using -std=c2x, and actual SCHC compile command ends in -std=c2x (not c99). The original unrecognized-option failure is gone; bitstream.c compiled. Host AppleClang/CMake configuration succeeded and bitstream.c compiled. Both builds next stop at an unrelated pre-existing duplicate SCHC_BITMAP_MASK in schc.c/header; filed project-LICHEN-worker6-ebv7 and linked it to production blocker project-LICHEN-worker6-1obz. Pinned full build also exposes independent existing hardening/header failures after this point, outside this dialect bead. Isolation verify and git diff --check passed; workstation synced twice."}
